content:
We are moving into Day 6 of the massive Amazon Black Friday sale with many of the best Apple deals of the year. Alongside this 13-inch M5 iPad Pro at $350 off and the new OLED iPad mini at $100 off, we are also catching some even lower MacBook deals headlined by the new M6 Pro at $220 off (All-time low).

Those deals join the M5 MacBook Air at up to $300 off, MacBook Neo starting down at $649, the latest Mac mini from $779, and the first discounts on the latest M6 iMac at up to $110 off. All of that and more is waiting in detail below; just make sure you grab some 2026 Apple Polishing Cloths at $9 Prime shipped before they sell out again.

M5 MacBook Air

After the way pricing jumped on MacBooks this year, landing the latest M5 MacBook Air at up to $300 off is serious steal. With all colors of the entry 15-inch model and the 16GB/1TB 13-inch now sitting at a solid $300 off, this is a perfect time to land Apple’s most popular MacBook at dramatically less than they have been in nearly 6 months:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,049 (Reg. $1,299) – $250 off
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,299 (Reg. $1,599) – $300 off!
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,549 (Reg. $1,799) – $250 off
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,199 (Reg. $1,499) – $300 off!
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,549 (Reg. $1,799) – $250 off
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,749 (Reg. $1,999) – $250 off

M6 MacBook Pro

Apple unleashed its first MacBook with the new M6 earlier this month, and we are already tracking a major discount on the most affordable configuration. While this one was $150 off to start Black Friday Week, you can now land one at a seriously impressive $220 off the list price right now:

  • 14-inch M6 MacBook Pro 16GB/1TB $1,779 (Reg. $1,999) – $220 off all-time low
  • 14-inch M6 MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $2,049 (Reg. $2,199) – $150 off all-time low
  • 14-inch M6 MacBook Pro 32GB/1TB $2,249 (Reg. $2,399) – $150 off all-time low

MacBook Neo

Apple’s most affordable current-generation Mac and arguably the best laptop value on the planet right now (it certainly is to me). If you or someone on your list doesn’t need a MacBook for much more than some emails, social media, browsing the web, and YouTube action, you can get all that, Apple’s second-to-none macOS experience, and a brand new 2026 release from just $649 shipped right now – that’s approaching half the price of a M5 MacBook Air at Black Friday pricing:

  • MacBook Neo 256GB $649 (Reg. $700)
  • MacBook Neo 512GB $749 (Reg. $800)

M5 Pro MacBook Pro PROLED

But for the very best, most feature-rich MacBook experience, Apple’s brand new touch display PROLED machines are carrying their very first discounts for Black Friday 2026 – the Apple logo lights up again at up to $250 off right now:

  • 16-inch PROLED XDR MacBook Pro with touch 24GB/1TB $3,249 (Reg. $3,399)
  • 16-inch PROLED XDR MacBook Pro with touch 48GB/1TB $3,799 (Reg. $3,999)
  • 16-inch PROLED XDR MacBook Pro with touch 32GB/2TB $4,549 (Reg. $4,799)

M6 Mac mini

I love me a Mac mini, and I’m likely to upgrade to the new M6 model sometime this week. While not quite as low as the MacBook Neo, it is the most affordable way to land an Apple M series chip in your workstation, and you can now do so starting from $779 shipped:

  • M6 Mac mini 16GB/256GB $779 (Reg. $899)
  • M6 Mac mini 16GB/512GB $949 (Reg. $1,099)
  • M6 Mac mini 24GB/512GB $1,199 (Reg. $1,299)
  • M5 Pro Mac mini 24GB/512GB $1,549 (Reg. $1,699)

M6 iMac

The world’s greatest all-in-one desktop machine, a perfect machine for the whole family, and arguably the most gorgeous thing you can put on any desk, the new M6 iMac is catching is very first deals for Black Friday 2026 at up to $110 off:

  • Apple 2026 iMac M6, Blue 10-Core 16GB/256GB: $1,425 (Reg. $1,499) – All-time low
  • Apple 2026 iMac M6, Pink 10-Core, 16GB/256GB: $1,425 (Reg. $1,499) – All-time low
  • Apple 2026 iMac M6, Green 12-Core, 16GB/256GB: $1,613 (Reg. $1,699) – All-time low
  • Apple 2026 iMac M6, Silver 12-Core, 16GB/256GB: $1,613 (Reg. $1,699) – All-time low
  • Apple 2026 iMac M6, Blue 12-Core, 16GB/256GB: $1,613 (Reg. $1,699) – All-time low
  • Apple 2026 iMac M6, Yellow 12-Core, 16GB/256GB: $1,613 (Reg. $1,699) – All-time low
  • Apple 2026 iMac M6, Silver 12-Core, 16GB/512GB: $1,800 (Reg. $1,899) – All-time low
  • Apple 2026 iMac M6, Green 12-Core, 16GB/512GB: $1,988 (Reg. $2,099) – All-time low
